compose_override:
services:
  postgres:
    volumes: !override
      - ./.t14-p0/postgres-data:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    ports: !override
      - "127.0.0.1:55438:55433"
      - "127.0.0.1:8014:18001"
      - "127.0.0.1:5184:15174"
  runner:
    volumes: !override
      - ./.t14-p0/final-ci:/work/.t13/outputs
      - ./.t14-p0/final-playwright:/work/frontend/test-results
    environment:
      AGENTMALL_PAYMENT_EVIDENCE_DIR: /work/.t13/outputs/screenshots/payment
